description: Messaging layer via aweb: per-instance team identities, explicit joined teams with live receive, native aw mail/chat skills and the cross-machine team roster.

requires.why: aw >= 1.36.33: identity minting at spawn, self-delete at retire, live receive registration, onboarding, all agent messaging, replies to senders outside the team roster, grants that never expire, and resident creation with oats aweb resident create
the aweb channel extension for pi sessions — real-time mail/chat awakenings; without it a pi instance can send with `aw` but is never woken by incoming messages
requires.install: pi install npm:@awebai/pi, then, if the @awebai/pi installed is below 0.5.0, make its entry {"source": "npm:@awebai/pi", "skills": []} in the pi folder's settings.json (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, else ~/.pi/agent), so pi loads the extension without its bundled skills. Never install @awebai/claude-skills in a pi folder that OATS homes use: a home's skills come from its capabilities (README, "The pi extension without its skills")

requires.why: the aweb channel plugin for Claude Code sessions — real-time mail/chat awakenings; without it a Claude instance can send with `aw` but is never woken by incoming messages
requires.install: claude plugin marketplace add awebai/claude-plugins && claude plugin install aweb-channel@awebai-marketplace

requires.why: an ambient aweb pi extension, if one is installed, must honour AWEB_DELIVERY=session (0.3.10 and later); an older one would open a second event stream beside the wake broker; no extension at all is fine
requires.install: pi install npm:@awebai/pi@latest, then, if the @awebai/pi installed is below 0.5.0, make its entry {"source": "npm:@awebai/pi@latest", "skills": []} in the pi folder's settings.json (PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, else ~/.pi/agent), so pi loads the extension without its bundled skills. Never install @awebai/claude-skills in a pi folder that OATS homes use: a home's skills come from its capabilities (README, "The pi extension without its skills")

requires.why: an ambient aweb-channel plugin for Claude Code, if one is installed, must honour AWEB_DELIVERY=session (1.7.9 and later); an older one starts its own channel server beside the wake broker and can fetch and acknowledge a message before the broker delivers it; no plugin at all is fine
requires.install: update the aweb-channel plugin from the awebai marketplace in Claude Code

reasons: aw mail inbox does not advertise --count-only; unread-delivery attention counts are unknown. Upgrade aw to a build with read-only count support; failed counts never clear existing claims.
messaging settings and explicit binding selections are required
messaging input must match the supported binding contract
the requested messaging configuration is not qualified
messaging response exceeds the supported wire limits
captured bindings are not supported since oats.aweb 1.42.0; readiness takes a workspace context (oats readiness)

delivery.description: channel (default): Claude Code selects the aweb-channel plugin (admission/connection unverified) and pi selects the @awebai/pi extension for in-session delivery; Codex and any other runtime without an aweb channel go through the host wake broker (AWEB_DELIVERY=session). Every start re-decides by runtime and leaves the home on exactly one path. session: every runtime goes through the host wake broker (AWEB_DELIVERY=session), no channel flag.

claudeChannelMode.description: Host-selected Claude/channel request, only in oats-local.yaml. Development is the default for new compositions: development passes --dangerously-load-development-channels, and OATS confirms Claude's development-channel prompt at launch. Approved (the recommended unattended route) passes --channels and, with the machine's managed policy, avoids the prompt: Claude admits the plugin when that policy sets channelsEnabled and lists aweb-channel@awebai-marketplace in allowedChannelPlugins (see the oats-aweb skill, section 4). No automatic fallback, migration or flip-back; a future default change requires an explicit reviewed release. Pi, Codex and session routes are unchanged.

root.description: Host-owned absolute directory whose .aw is the aweb minting root. Put this only in oats-local.yaml settings.oats.aweb.root; use oats aweb setup to initialize it.

roots.description: Host-owned map of aweb team id to absolute directory whose .aw is that team's minting root, for deployments that mint into several teams. Put this only in oats-local.yaml settings.oats.aweb.roots. Keys are team ids only.

identity.description: Identity selection. mode=local (default) mints an instance-local team identity or uses the existing identity.source retained-seat flow. mode=global acts as a named resident identity through a session grant; requires identity.resident. Optional global fields: profile (normal|reviewer), scopes (explicit concrete grant scope list, wins over profile), ttl (never, or a Go duration from 60s to 720h; default never), e2ee (default true), renew (off|launch, default launch).

residents.description: Host-owned map for global mode: resident name to absolute custody directory whose .aw holds the resident root keys and team certificate. Put this only in oats-local.yaml settings.oats.aweb.residents; committed workspace or soul files must never carry custody paths.

join.description: comma-separated eligible team labels to join at spawn; values are workspace-defined labels and the default is absent. Joined teams receive live through the host wake broker where the runtime supports it, else by polling.

health.description: Host-owned agent status publisher (aweb-acah.3), only in oats-local.yaml settings.oats.aweb.health: publish (true to publish every agent's status to aweb from the host timer once a minute; absent or false publishes nothing), language (BCP 47 tag for the status texts; en when absent or unknown), operator (the role named when a person must fix something, one line of at most 120 bytes; default "Its operator"). Set with `oats aweb health enable|disable`. Publishing needs aw >= 1.36.38; proving a channel home receives needs Claude channel 1.7.17 or pi extension 0.3.15. The same opt-in tick observes unread mail with active or persistent broker errors (grant-backed seats excluded) and emits oats.aweb attention claims when the runtime kernel advertises waiting-on-you and aw supports mail inbox --count-only; without the tick no such claim appears.

teams.description: Read-only structured JSON summary of eligible and joined aweb teams for this home.

join.description: Join comma-separated eligible aweb team labels for this home.

args.name: labels
args.description: Comma-separated eligible team labels to join.

args.name: labels
args.description: Comma-separated joined team labels to leave.

args.description: Declared team label; defaults to selected default team.
